"""Physical preview benchmark: only our own window, no desktop controls/images saved."""
import ctypes as C
from ctypes import wintypes as W
import logging
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
from hand_tracking import hand_tracker as app
from camera.capture_timeline import CaptureTimeline
from hand_tracking.performance import write_report

started=[];phase=[];transitions=[]
begin=CaptureTimeline.begin
create=app.create_preview_window
def measured(timeline):
    begin(timeline);started[:]=[time.perf_counter()]
def own_window(title):
    window=create(title);api=window.api
    if api is None:raise OSError('Native owned Win32 window required')
    api._bind('ShowWindow',[W.HWND,C.c_int],W.BOOL)
    original=window.state
    def state():
        if started:
            index=min(2,int((time.perf_counter()-started[0])/20))
            if phase != [index]:
                if not api.owned(window.hwnd,title):return 'closed'
                api.user.ShowWindow(window.hwnd,6 if index==1 else 9)
                phase[:]=[index];transitions.append({'index':index,'at':time.perf_counter()})
        return original()
    window.state=state
    return window
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO,format='%(asctime)s %(levelname)s: %(message)s')
args=app.parse_args(['--face-detection','--capture-pipeline','latest-thread',
    '--windows-timer-policy','honor-requests','--gestures','--pinch','--gesture-states','--swipes',
    '--benchmark','--warmup','5','--duration','60'])
report={}
with patch.object(CaptureTimeline,'begin',measured),patch.object(app,'create_preview_window',own_window):
    app.run(args,report)
report['owned_preview_schedule']=transitions
report['physical_limitations']='Window state, hand and face counts are measured; only own preview minimized/restored. No controls or saved images.'
write_report('hand_tracking/benchmarks/phase4_1_combined_preview_r1.json',report)

windows_timer_policy.power_note: Honoring existing timer requests while minimized can increase wakeups/CPU/power; energy not measured.

face_detector.detector: MediaPipe FaceDetector / BlazeFace short-range float16 v1
face_detector.primary_policy: confidence descending, area descending, then box coordinates ascending
